token_budget_basis.schema_burden: deterministic typed feature projection and ordering
token_budget_basis.materiality_and_quality_risk: using generic semantic similarity as final authority promotes related background; using labels or per-case phrases would overfit the development cases

token_budget_basis.reasoning_profile: zero-call deterministic financial evaluator; generic rerankers are tie-break inputs only
token_budget_basis.stop_and_truncation: rank every candidate in the frozen union, emit at most twelve review rows per atom, fail closed on digest or identity drift
